title: Smoky Stew with Tofu
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with smoky flavors and tender tofu, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the tofu, tomato paste, and Chinese Five-spice powder to the pot. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, water, and browned sausage back to the pot.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
